title: fix(gateway): keep worker bootstrap within lint limits
body:
Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160442

## What Problem This Solves

Worker bootstrap exceeds the repository's unchanged production and test line caps, blocking validation of otherwise unrelated fixes. This is a maintainer-requested prerequisite for the active waveform and lint repair work.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior changes. Bootstrap validation can proceed without raising lint limits or removing test coverage.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing command-result module now owns the identical exit-code/stderr/stdout failure predicate used at three bootstrap call sites. The existing result and fake-runner test helpers move unchanged into a sibling test-support module.

Error precedence, marker matching, callback ordering, response consumption, test cases, assertions, hooks and execution order are preserved. No configuration, lint threshold, baseline or generated bootstrap script changes.

## Evidence

- Scoped independent AutoReview found no actionable findings.
- [Remote bootstrap proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37087412077): all 38 tests passed, with zero skipped/failed tests or unhandled errors. Formatting passed without changing any of the four source hashes.
- The first changed-check attempt failed because its default comparison included unrelated main growth in agent and cron files. That failure is retained, not counted as a passing gate.
- [Missing-check continuation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37088093177) passed the complete changed-check gate, including all 27 dependent test typecheck graphs, targeted lint with zero warnings/errors, policy guards and diff verification. It binds the true candidate base `9ae1a44bf05d6140d35b7339d2606acd59bbac71` and verifies exactly the four intended files and unchanged source hashes. Controller exit 0, settled native receipt and completed lease verified; the 38 tests were not replayed. Backing Actions cancellation during one-shot lease cleanup is not an application failure.
- [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37089666732) and required checks passed. [Completed ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163959#issuecomment-5964616377) has no actionable findings or before-merge items. Native completed-hosted preparation passed on the same signed head without a rebase or source change; native squash is the remaining step. All application proof ran remotely.
